name: SimplyUtils Widgets
author: simplyutils

sections.description:
SimplyUtils Widgets adds five small, useful tools to your site with one block or shortcode:

  • Countdown timer: a live countdown to an event, a sale or an exam. Every visitor counts down to the same moment, shown in their own time zone, and it says when the event has started.
  • Word counter: words, characters with and without spaces, sentences, paragraphs and reading time, as visitors type.
  • Age calculator: exact age in years, months and days, total days and the next birthday.
  • Percentage calculator: X% of Y, what percent X is of Y, percent change, reverse percentage, and adding or taking off a percentage.
  • Unit converter: length, weight, temperature, volume, speed, area, data and time.

Each widget fits its content height, follows a light or dark color setting, and needs no account or API key. Visitors’ text, dates and numbers are processed in their own browser.

How to use

  • Block editor: add the “SimplyUtils widget” block, then choose the widget in the block settings.
  • Shortcode: [simplyutils tool="word-counter"]. Tools: date-countdown-calculator, word-counter, age-calculator, percentage-calculator, unit-converter. Options: theme="dark", height="500". For the countdown: date="2026-12-31" time="23:59" title="New Year" (the time uses your site’s time zone).

Credit link

The plugin adds no links to your pages by default. If you would like to thank us, you can turn on a small “Free … by SimplyUtils” link in Settings → SimplyUtils Widgets.

External services

This plugin shows widgets from SimplyUtils (https://simplyutils.com), a free tools website run by Memegician LLC.

  • What is loaded: each widget is a page from https://simplyutils.com/embed/ shown in an iframe on your page. It loads when a visitor views a page that contains a widget.
  • What is sent: the visitor’s browser requests the widget page from simplyutils.com, which includes the usual request data (IP address, browser user agent, and the page address as referrer). The countdown’s date and event name are part of the widget address. Text, dates and numbers that visitors type into a widget are processed in their browser and are not sent to SimplyUtils.
  • Terms of use: https://simplyutils.com/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://simplyutils.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins → Add New, or upload the simplyutils-widgets folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Add the “SimplyUtils widget” block to a post or page, or use the [simplyutils] shortcode.
  3. Optional: Settings → SimplyUtils Widgets to show a credit link.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Yes. The plugin and the widgets are free, with no account or API key.

Does it slow down my site?

Widgets load lazily, only when a visitor scrolls near them, and the plugin adds one tiny script that resizes the widget to fit.

Can I use it in the Classic editor or a page builder?

Yes. Use the [simplyutils] shortcode in any place that accepts shortcodes.

Why does my countdown not show?

Set a date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Logged-in editors see a short note when the date is missing; visitors see nothing.
